trial_title: Monoclonal Antibody Therapy in Treating Patients With Leptomeningeal Cancer
brief_summary:
RATIONALE: Monoclonal antibodies can locate tumor cells and either kill them or deliver tumor-killing substances to them without harming normal cells.

PURPOSE: Phase I trial to study the effectiveness of monoclonal antibody therapy in treating patients who have leptomeningeal metastases.

eligibility_table.criterion: Histologically confirmed malignancy expressing GD2, including, but not limited to: Medulloblastoma/primitive neuroectodermal tumor of the CNS, Malignant glioma, Neuroblastoma, Retinoblastoma, Ependymoma, Sarcoma, Melanoma, Small cell lung carcinoma
eligibility_table.justification: Anaplastic astrocytoma is a type of malignant glioma, but GD2 expression is not typically associated with this tumor type.
